integrity: All assertions are bounded by an exhaustive finite computation with an acyclic integral Morse matching, explicit signed homology-cycle lifts, and separately reproduced mod-two checks. No external independent audit or publication claim.
scientific_limitations: Finite bidirected triangular prism only; homology and rational group character, not complete homotopy type or general prism family. Indexed-literature comparisons cannot prove absolute uniqueness.
title: Integral multipath homology and full symmetry of the bidirected triangular prism
